choose: Choose your payment provider. If it is not in the list, choose Other.
notSetUp: {provider} is not set up on this server yet.
verifiedWith: Verified with {provider} through {access, select, oauth {read-only access} other {a read-only key}}.

placeholders.airwallexAccount: Client ID shown with your API keys

stripe.dashboard: Create a read-only key in Stripe
stripe.reads: subscriptions, invoices, charges, Checkout Sessions and disputes
stripe.step1: Stripe opens a new restricted key with its name and permissions filled in.
stripe.step2: Check that Read is set for {permissions} and None for everything else, then choose Create key.
stripe.step3: Copy the key, which starts with rk_live_, and paste it below.
stripe.noHistory: No revenue history yet. Replace the key with one that also has Invoices: Read to show the last 12 months as a chart.
stripe.skipped: {count, plural, one {# usage-based item was not counted.} other {# usage-based items were not counted.}}

paddle.step1: Under Developer tools → Authentication, choose New API key.
paddle.step2: Give it Read for Subscriptions and Transactions and no other permissions. Leave the expiry date empty, or the key stops working when it expires.
paddle.step3: Copy the key, which starts with pdl_live_apikey_, and paste it below.
paddle.noHistory: No revenue history: the Paddle account has more transactions than one verification reads.
paddle.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription without a paid charge was not counted.} other {# subscriptions without a paid charge were not counted.}}

polar.step1: In your organization's Settings → Developers, choose New Token.
polar.step2: Select the scopes organizations:read, subscriptions:read and orders:read and nothing else, and choose No expiration.
polar.step3: Copy the token, which starts with polar_oat_, and paste it below.
polar.noHistory: No revenue history: the Polar account has more orders than one verification reads.
polar.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription was not counted.} other {# subscriptions were not counted.}}

dodo.step1: Under Developer → API Keys, choose Add API Key.
dodo.step2: Turn off Enable write access, so the key can only read.
dodo.step3: Copy the key, which Dodo Payments shows only once, and paste it below.
dodo.noHistory: No revenue history: Dodo Payments does not say which period a payment covers.
dodo.skipped: {count, plural, one {# tax-inclusive subscription without a payment was not counted.} other {# tax-inclusive subscriptions without a payment were not counted.}}

creem.step1: Under Developers → API keys, create a new key.
creem.step2: In the scope picker, give it read access to products, subscriptions and transactions and nothing else.
creem.step3: Copy the key, which starts with creem_, and paste it below.
creem.noHistory: No revenue history: the Creem account has more transactions than one verification reads.
creem.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription without a readable price or payment was not counted.} other {# subscriptions without a readable price or payment were not counted.}}

chargebee.step1: Open Settings → Configure Chargebee → API keys and events, and choose Add API key.
chargebee.step2: Choose a Read-only key with access to all data, or restricted to transactional data.
chargebee.step3: Copy the key, and enter your site: the name before .chargebee.com in your dashboard's address.
chargebee.noHistory: No revenue history: the Chargebee site has more invoices than one verification reads.
chargebee.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription without a paid invoice was not counted.} other {# subscriptions without a paid invoice were not counted.}}

whop.reads: memberships, plans, promo codes and payments
whop.step1: Choose your business, open Developer → Account API keys and create a key with custom permissions.
whop.step2: Give it only member:basic:read, plan:basic:read, payment:basic:read and promo_code:basic:read. A key with any permission beyond reading is refused.
whop.step3: Copy the key and paste it below.
whop.noHistory: No revenue history: the Whop account has more payments or plans than one verification reads.
whop.skipped: {count, plural, one {# tax-inclusive membership without a payment was not counted.} other {# tax-inclusive memberships without a payment were not counted.}}

revenuecat.reads: your project's MRR, active subscriptions and revenue charts
revenuecat.step1: In your project, open Project settings → API keys and choose New secret API key with version V2.
revenuecat.step2: Set Charts & metrics to Read only and everything else to No access. A key with more access is refused.
revenuecat.step3: Copy the key, which starts with sk_, and the project ID, which follows /projects/ in the address of any page in your project.
revenuecat.noHistory: No revenue history yet. Refresh to read RevenueCat's MRR chart.
revenuecat.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription was not counted.} other {# subscriptions were not counted.}}

gumroad.dashboard: See the apps connected to your Gumroad account
gumroad.step1: Save with the button at the end of the form. Gumroad opens, and asks you to sign in if you are not.
gumroad.step2: Approve View your sales. That is the only access asked for: it cannot change products, refund sales or email your customers.
gumroad.step3: Gumroad sends you back here, and the revenue is verified.
gumroad.noHistory: No revenue history: the Gumroad account has more sales than one verification reads.
gumroad.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscriber without a recent charge was not counted.} other {# subscribers without a recent charge were not counted.}}

paypal.step1: Sign in with your PayPal business account, check that Live is selected, and choose Create App.
paypal.step2: In the new app's features, turn on Transaction search and turn off everything else. An app that can do more than search transactions is refused.
paypal.step3: Copy the Client ID and Secret key 1, and paste them below. MRR counts PayPal subscriptions; other payments count as revenue.
paypal.noHistory: No revenue history: the PayPal account has more subscription payments than one verification reads.
paypal.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription was not counted.} other {# subscriptions were not counted.}}

mollie.step1: Choose Build your own advanced access token, and give it Read for Payments and Subscriptions only. A token that can do more than read is refused.
mollie.step2: Copy the token, which starts with access_. API keys (live_ or test_) can create payments and are not accepted.
mollie.step3: Copy the ID of this product's website profile, which starts with pfl_, from Developers → API keys. MRR counts Mollie subscriptions; other payments count as revenue.
mollie.noHistory: No revenue history: the Mollie profile has more payments than one verification reads.
mollie.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription with an unreadable billing interval was not counted.} other {# subscriptions with an unreadable billing interval were not counted.}}

paystack.step1: Switch the dashboard to Live, open Developers and create a restricted key.
paystack.step2: Give it only plans:read, transactions:read and disputes_refunds:read. Never paste your secret key (sk_), which can do everything.
paystack.step3: Confirm with your dashboard password, then copy the key, which starts with rk_ and is shown once, and paste it below.
paystack.noHistory: No revenue history: the key cannot read transactions, or the Paystack account has more of them than one verification reads.
paystack.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription without a readable plan was not counted.} other {# subscriptions without a readable plan were not counted.}}

abacatepay.reads: your store's MRR, active subscriptions and revenue by day
abacatepay.step1: Leave test mode (Modo teste), open Apps and find Trust MRR.
abacatepay.step2: Turn the app on and choose Salvar configurações. API keys, which start with abc_, are refused.
abacatepay.step3: Copy the token, which starts with mrr_, and paste it below.
abacatepay.noHistory: No revenue history yet. Refresh to read AbacatePay's daily MRR.
abacatepay.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription was not counted.} other {# subscriptions were not counted.}}

asaas.step1: As an administrator, open Integrações → Chaves de API and create a key.
asaas.step2: Give it Read for Assinaturas (Subscriptions) and Cobranças (Charges) only, with no IP allowlist. A key created without permissions has full access and is refused.
asaas.step3: Copy the key, which starts with $aact_prod_ and is shown once, and paste it below.
asaas.noHistory: No revenue history: the Asaas account has more subscriptions or charges than one verification reads.
asaas.skipped: {count, plural, one {# active subscription without a recent payment was not counted.} other {# active subscriptions without a recent payment were not counted.}}

airwallex.step1: Under Settings → Developer → API keys, choose New scoped API key.
airwallex.step2: Give it Read for Subscriptions and Invoices (Billing) and for Payment Acceptance, and nothing else. A key that can read more is refused.
airwallex.step3: Copy the key and the Client ID shown with it, and paste them below. MRR counts Airwallex Billing subscriptions; other payments count as revenue.
airwallex.noHistory: No revenue history: the Airwallex account has more subscription invoices than one verification reads.
airwallex.skipped: {count, plural, one {# usage-based item or subscription paid outside Airwallex was not counted.} other {# usage-based items or subscriptions paid outside Airwallex were not counted.}}

superwall.reads: your app's MRR, active subscriptions and proceeds charts
superwall.step1: Under Settings → API Keys, create a key.
superwall.step2: Give it only the charts:read scope, limited to the app's project if you like. A key with more access is refused.
superwall.step3: Copy the key, which starts with sk_, and paste it below with the address of your app's dashboard.
superwall.noHistory: No revenue history yet. Refresh to read Superwall's MRR chart.
superwall.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription was not counted.} other {# subscriptions were not counted.}}

appstore.dashboard: Open App Store Connect's API keys
appstore.step1: In Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API, open Team Keys and choose Generate API Key.
appstore.step2: Under Access, choose Sales with access to reports, or Finance. A key that can do more, such as Admin or App Manager, is refused.
appstore.step3: Download the .p8 file and paste its contents below, with the Issuer ID, the Key ID and your vendor number from Payments and Financial Reports.
appstore.noHistory: No revenue history yet. Refresh to read Apple's subscription reports of the last 12 months.
appstore.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription on a paid offer was not counted.} other {# subscriptions on a paid offer were not counted.}}

googleplay.step1: Create a service account without roles, and under Keys add a JSON key.
googleplay.step2: In Play Console, open Users and permissions, invite the service account's email, and give it only View financial data.
googleplay.step3: On Download reports, copy the Cloud Storage URI of the financial reports, and paste it below with your app's package name and the JSON key. A new permission can take some hours to apply.
googleplay.noHistory: No revenue history: the Google Play sales reports are larger than one verification reads.
googleplay.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription charge that could not be read was not counted.} other {# subscription charges that could not be read were not counted.}}

zoho.dashboard: See the apps connected to your Zoho account
zoho.step1: Save with the button at the end of the form. Zoho opens, and asks you to sign in if you are not.
zoho.step2: Approve read access to settings, subscriptions and payments. That is the only access asked for: it cannot change anything.
zoho.step3: Zoho sends you back here, and your default Zoho Billing organization is verified. To verify another, make it the default first.
zoho.noHistory: No revenue history: Zoho Billing does not say which period an invoice covers.
zoho.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription without a readable price or billing period was not counted.} other {# subscriptions without a readable price or billing period were not counted.}}

mercadopago.step1: Save with the button at the end of the form. Mercado Pago opens, and asks you to sign in if you are not.
mercadopago.step2: Allow access. That is the only access asked for: it can only read, and cannot charge, refund or change anything.
mercadopago.step3: Mercado Pago sends you back here, and the revenue is verified.
mercadopago.noHistory: No revenue history: the Mercado Pago account has more payments than one verification reads, or its payments do not name their subscriptions.
mercadopago.skipped: {count, plural, one {# subscription without a readable amount or frequency was not counted.} other {# subscriptions without a readable amount or frequency were not counted.}}
